beats.objective: Decide who gets the light back

first_night.speaker: patron
first_night.text: {patron.first} {patron.family} has a lantern on the counter of {patron.place}. "Power's been jumpy all week, {courier.first}. Take the order before the fridge dies."

flicker.speaker: patron
flicker.text: The corridor lights die, come back, die again. Somewhere below, {power.name} announces "maintenance". Nobody believes them.

neighbour_door.speaker: neighbour
neighbour_door.text: {neighbour.first} {neighbour.family} sits in the dark with a blanket. "Forty years in this block and I've never seen a cut like this. Someone did this on purpose."

engineer_meet.speaker: engineer
engineer_meet.text: {engineer.first} {engineer.family}, a line engineer with grease to the elbows, looks up. "The cables weren't worn. They were cut, clean. I can splice them if someone brings me relay parts without {power.name} noticing."

engineer_parts.speaker: engineer
engineer_parts.text: {engineer.first} weighs the relays in one hand. "These came from a {power.name} store. Funny how they had spares while we had none."

saboteur_meet.speaker: saboteur
saboteur_meet.text: {saboteur.first} {saboteur.family} doesn't run. "{power.name} paid me to cut the lines so the council would sign their new contract. I've got the transfer slips. What are you going to do about it?"

the_switch.speaker: engineer
the_switch.text: The splice is ready, the slips are in your bag, and {disruptor.name} are offering good money to keep the district dark a little longer.

choices.text: Throw the switch and bring the light back.
Take the slips to the council.
Take the gang's money and walk away.

epilogue_restore.speaker: neighbour
epilogue_restore.text: Window by window the block lights up again. {neighbour.first} waves from the balcony, and {patron.place} hands out free noodles all night.

epilogue_expose.speaker: engineer
epilogue_expose.text: The slips are read out in the council chamber. {power.name} loses its contract; {disruptor.name} lose their payday and remember who cost them.

epilogue_dark.speaker: disruptor
epilogue_dark.text: The money is real. So is the dark. Prices climb as generators become the only light, and {disruptor.name} sell the fuel.
